svg.title: MTP leads through 128K and DFlash2 leads at 512K
svg.desc: Median streaming decode on four Arc Pro B70 GPUs with a one-million-token target pool. MTP measured 109.2, 82.3, 50.0, and 37.2 tokens per second at 32K, 128K, 256K, and 512K input. DFlash2 measured 71.4, 58.1, 49.1, and 42.2. Each long-context cell is one reported prompt after one warm-up.
svg.title: MTP leads through 128K and DFlash2 leads at 512K
